description: A component that owns the state and renders `<Context value={...}>{children}</Context>`. Consumers never see the raw context.
A custom hook that reads the context and throws when it is `null`, reporting a missing provider.
A context value memoized with `useMemo` (and functions with `useCallback`) so it only changes when its data changes.
React 19 API to read a context; unlike `useContext` it can be called inside conditions and loops.
Each rendered provider creates an independent state instance for its subtree; the nearest provider wins.
